pages.title: Bigjigs Toys Cutting Vegetables Crate
pages.description: Bigjigs Toys Cutting Vegetables Crate, a selection of brightly coloured wooden Vegetables that can be sliced up with the aid of a wooden knife
pages.ld_description:
Bigjigs Toys Cutting Vegetables Crate, a selection of brightly coloured wooden Vegetables that can be sliced up carefully and accurately with the aid of a wooden knife, encouraging creative and imaginative role play whilst instilling the virtues of good food and healthy eating.

Kids play food set includes a carrot, tomato, cucumber, onion, mushroom and more!. All of the fruits feature velcro fastenings, so kids can safely slice them up with the wooden knife on the chopping board included.

Wooden play food is fantastic for helping children learn all about the importance of a healthy and balanced diet, where our food comes from and how we prepare our meals. Once playtime is over, the wooden food can then be stored back in the storage crate.

Boosts kids’ fine motor skills, imagination and creativity through imaginary play sessions. Bigjigs Toys Cutting Vegetables Crate is made from high quality, responsibly sourced materials. Conforms to current European safety standards.

 	Cutting play food set
 	7 pieces of wooden Vegetables
 	1 wooden knife and chopping board
 	1 Vegetable crate
 	Inspires creative role play
 	Suitable for 18+ months

Dimensions   W18cm,  H 5cm, D 14.5cm
